rule: Every Phase 6 manifest scenario has exactly one original-plan owner and an observable product path; the owner is an IMP-Px-WPy.z identifier, not a remediation graph node.

scenarios.required_path: Original Phase 6 WP6.2 validation-run and rule-version persistence path: execute a run against rule version 3, commit rule version 4 through the real rule-update path, read the original run from PostgreSQL unchanged, and execute a new run that records version 4.
scenarios.assertion_rule: Execute the exact tagged scenario with observable persisted-state assertions; no mock, @wip, skip, fixture mutation or in-memory substitute.
